page: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-4 is an efficient x86_64 server instance powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.2 GHz. The instance features 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyperthreading and dedicated CPU allocation. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The processor cache hierarchy includes 32 KB L1d, 0.5 MB L2, and 16 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA, while AVX-512 is not supported. The instance includes no GPU acceleration and no bundled local storage.

In performance benchmarks, the e2-standard-4 demonstrates entry-level compute and memory bandwidth capabilities. Single-core stress-ng tests achieved a score of 1105.89, while multi-core performance reached 2907.35. Geekbench evaluation recorded a single-core score of 847.0 and a multi-core score of 1906.0, alongside a software compilation score of 2573.0. Memory bandwidth benchmarks measured 161.16 GB/sec for cached 16 KB read operations and 24.13 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB read operations. Database throughput reached 4.02 million operations per second in Redis SET tests, while static web serving throughput reached 4.19 GB/sec. Large language model inference using a small 135M parameter model yielded 258.44 tokens per second for prompt processing and 104.71 tokens per second for text generation.

The e2-standard-4 provides an entry-tier cost profile for workload deployments requiring a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio without requiring high-throughput compute or local drive space. Key hardware tradeoffs include lower overall single-threaded clock speed, absence of local NVMe storage, and lower memory bandwidth relative to higher-tier instance families. The system is suited for lightweight microservices, internal dev/test environments, basic static web serving, low-traffic database nodes, and small utility workloads.
description: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-4 is a general-purpose x86_64 cloud server featuring an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.2 GHz. The instance offers 4 dedicated vCPUs from 2 physical cores with hyperthreading and is paired with 16.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per vCPU). CPU cache features 16 MB L3 cache with support for AVX, AES, and FMA instruction sets, but omits AVX-512. The instance contains no bundled local storage or discrete GPU acceleration. Benchmarks indicate entry-level compute performance, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 1906.0, Redis SET operations reaching 4.02 million per second, and static web serving throughput measuring 4.19 GB/sec. Small LLM inference using a 135M model generates 104.71 tokens per second. The e2-standard-4 offers a cost-effective, balanced resource ratio suitable for lightweight microservices, web applications, dev/test environments, and low-traffic backends where high memory or computational throughput is not required.
